concept: EBS: encryption by default at the account/Region level
tests: Simplest way to guarantee encryption of all new EBS volumes.
expected: Enable EBS encryption by default in the Region: all new volumes and their snapshots are encrypted automatically. Triggers: "always encrypted", "without relying on developers", "simplest".
why_not: Manual audits are reactive; an SCP denying RunInstances blocks all launches; encrypting only snapshots doesn't protect new volumes.
